notes: Stun (Thunder Tap, Thunder Sweep and every stun): the dizzy ring; anchor = the ring centre; sit it on top of the head
Taunt (Gong Wave, Searing Lid, Provoke, Iron Kitchen): anchor = its centre; draw it over the mob's head (above the HP bar line) for as long as the effect lasts
Armor Crack debuff: anchor = its centre; draw it over the mob's head (above the HP bar line) for as long as the effect lasts; with several debuffs, line them up side by side
Marked debuff: anchor = its centre; draw it over the mob's head (above the HP bar line) for as long as the effect lasts; side by side with other debuffs
Eye Sting debuff: anchor = its centre; draw it over the mob's head (above the HP bar line) for as long as the effect lasts; side by side with other debuffs
Numbing Oil debuff: anchor = its centre; draw it over the mob's head (above the HP bar line) for as long as the effect lasts; side by side with other debuffs
Iron Kitchen, back: far half of the ring, behind the player; anchor = the player's feet; play once on cast
Iron Kitchen, front: near half of the ring + shields and steam, in front of the player; same anchor and timing
Blood Price, back: far half of the ring, behind the player; anchor = the player's feet; loop while the buff lasts
Blood Price, front: near half of the ring + rising drops; same anchor, loop
Mist Veil, back: far half of the ring, behind the player; anchor = the player's feet; play once on cast
Mist Veil, front: near half of the ring + mist wisps; same anchor and timing
Hyper Regen, back: far half of the ring, behind the player; anchor = the player's feet; loop while the buff lasts
Hyper Regen, front: near half of the ring + rising sparks; same anchor, loop
Fierce Stance, back: far half of the ring, behind the player; anchor = the player's feet; play once when the stance is taken
Fierce Stance, front: near half of the ring + ribbons and dashes; same anchor and timing
Flow Stance, back: far half of the ring, behind the player; anchor = the player's feet; play once when the stance is taken
Flow Stance, front: near half of the ring + ribbons and dashes; same anchor and timing
